clouds.note: Ominous banks rolling in off the sea and piling up behind the Saltgate; the supermoon still hangs clear above the island.

rain.note: Dry. Wind only, and the smell of rain coming.

lightning.note: None yet; the storm is still gathering.

phases.note: Cold moonlit dusk on the island before the player first sets off; the storm is on its way.

clouds.note: Darker and fuller; only a few sparse wisps cross the moon, so the light on the water comes and goes.

rain.note: Starts soon after leaving the island: light at first, then steady.

lightning.note: Still none: the first flash waits for the burner.

phases.note: The crossing to fetch the burner: rain starting, moonlight on the sea, Saint Calder's windows ahead.

clouds.note: Dense, billowing near-black cloud, low and fast, lit at the edges; the moon shows through a few sparse clouds, cold and bright on the water. Beneath it a second, darker, ragged layer drifts slowly across the sky and over the moon; the lightning lights it through.

rain.note: Heavy, wind-driven rain across the bow.

lightning.note: A forked bolt runs between the clouds and strobes the cloud around it two to four times; for an instant the rocks drop into black silhouette.

phases.note: Burner aboard: the storm breaks. Darker skies, lightning between the clouds, the moon the one steady light.

clouds.note: The storm holds near full strength; the beacon's sweep catches the cloud base on each turn.

lightning.note: Barely fewer flashes than the return; the relit beacon is what changes, not the storm.

phases.note: The beacon sweeps the water; the sea is readable again.

moon.look: A huge, low supermoon, cold silver, hanging over the Gullwater.
moon.position_note: Low in the north, on the far side of the lighthouse from the Saltgate: it lights the crossings from behind the lighthouse and leaves the sky over Saint Calder dark, so the city's windows are the only light there.
moon.eclipse_note: Later the Flighted ship slides across it, leaving a black sphere with a faint silver rim, and the moonlight drops away. Not part of this pass.

lightning.note: Cold silver-white flash between the clouds with a short afterglow, from the RETURN on; flashes place hazards in black silhouette against the sea.

sources.behaviour: Rotating beam; dark, then failing flicker, then steady sweep once relit.
Harsh crackling arc with a dynamo hum flicker.
Slow pulsing furnace glow that rises when coal is fed.
Dim warm window light with a slight gas flicker.
Steady brass lantern that sways with the hull; does not reveal hazards beyond its range.
Lit windows on emissive cards; each flickers on its own (a test), brighter the closer the player gets.

saint_calder.technique: Emissive window cards and a cathedral silhouette billboard, glow scaled by the player's distance and depth-faded by fog; no real lights.
saint_calder.seen_from_lighthouse: A faint scatter of amber window lights low on the far shore, just visible through the haze.
saint_calder.seen_from_saltgate: Rows of lit amber and gold windows climbing the hill behind the quays, the cathedral above them.
saint_calder.flicker: Test: the windows flicker, each on its own - a few at a time dim and recover, never in step; the cathedral stays steady.
saint_calder.note: Scenery only: warm window light in the relative darkness the moon leaves over the city. It must not line up as a goal marker for the crossing.

legibility_checks: Hazards: at RETURN the nearest rock reads as a silhouette at its hazard_visibility_m with no flash.
Lightning: a flash never washes out a hazard to white; hazards read darker than the sea during a flash.
Beacon: dark at the start, then relit; the sweep is visible from DOCK_PORT without being a marker.
Saint Calder: visible through fog from the outbound start, amber and gold only, never brighter than the beacon.
Photosensitivity: record 60 s of RETURN and confirm no more than 3 flashes in any second.
Moon: on both crossings the moonlit sea reads clearly and rocks show as dark shapes against it without a flash.
Rain: at RETURN intensity the rain never hides a hazard inside its hazard_visibility_m.
open_creator_decisions: Keep Saint Calder's window flicker after the vibe test, or make the windows steady.
